title: Gyeonghoeru Pavilion (경회루) and Gyeonghoeji Pond (경회루 연지).
comment:
Gyeonghoeru Pavilion (경회루) and Gyeonghoeji Pond (경회루 연지).

2026.05.17
Fujifilm XT-5, XF18-135mm @ 25mm, 1/500sec, ƒ 5.6, ISO 125
경복궁 (Gyeongbokgung Palace)

The thing about solo traveling in a country that doesn't natively speak English, is that you end up having some nice conversations with other English speakers. This doesn't always mean English is the other person's first language, but there's just enough to communicate.

I had a chance to reflect on this "English-speaking privilege" in front of this pavilion, after having asked a stranger to get my photo using my one-shot Instax camera. This other traveler was... Romanian, I think, and he actually asked for me to take his photo with the Instax as well. As with many of these transient travel conversations, we went our separate ways without exchanging contact information. But, it's fun to think that somewhere out there, there's someone with a small instant-film photo of themselves that came out of a conversation with another traveler.
